newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HOECHST REACHES AGREEMENT ON CLARIANT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: HOECHST REACHES AGREEMENT ON CLARIANT DEAL.

text.p: Chemicals firm Hoechst South Africa Ltd said on Thursday that it had reached agreement in principle to sell its speciality chemicals division to Clariant Southern Africa Ltd, a unit of Clariant AG.
Hoechst said details of the price and financial effects of the deal would be announced in due course and until then shareholders should use caution when dealing in its shares.
The move followed news that German parent Hoechst AG and Clariant were to combine their speciality chemicals interests.
